Title: Open the log from GitHub Pages
User Story: As a user, I want the app at a GitHub Pages web address, so that I can write from any device
User Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: Given a change on the main branch, when it is pushed, then the site is rebuilt and published
AC2: Given I open https://joisse1101.github.io/the-log/ on a phone or a laptop, when it loads, then it is served over HTTPS and the app page is shown
AC3: Given the build fails, when I open the address, then the live site is still the last good version
Notes: The repository is joisse1101/the-log. Hosting is the only story in its Feature.

Title: Connect GitHub with an access token
User Story: As a user, I want to paste my GitHub access token, so that the app can store my log under my account
User Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: Given a valid access token with gist permission, when I connect, then my GitHub username is shown
AC2: Given an invalid or expired access token, when I connect, then I am told it was refused and nothing is stored
AC3: Given a valid access token without gist permission, when I connect, then I am told which permission is missing
AC4: Given I am connected, when I reopen the app in the same browser, then I am still connected
AC5: Given nothing is entered, when I connect, then I am told an access token is needed and nothing is stored
AC6: Given GitHub cannot be reached, when I connect, then I am told the connection failed and I am not shown as connected
Notes: Paste-a-token was chosen over a Sign in with GitHub button, which would need a hosted helper service and is deferred. The token is kept in the browser.
Clarifications:
Q1: Do GitHub fine-grained tokens still lack gist access, so that only a classic token with the gist permission works? To be verified in the first build.
A1:

Title: Link or create a gist
User Story: As a user, I want to pick an existing gist or create a new one for my log, so that my data lives where I choose
User Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: Given I am connected, when I choose to create a new gist and pick private or public, then a gist of that kind is created and linked, and a public choice first warns me that anyone can read my thoughts
AC2: Given I paste the ID of a gist I own, when I link it, then it is linked, its thoughts show and it is labelled private or public
AC3: Given an ID that does not exist or belongs to someone else, when I link it, then I am told and nothing is linked
AC4: Given a gist whose file is not in the log format, when I link it, then I am warned before it is used
AC5: Given GitHub cannot be reached, when I create or link a gist, then I am told it failed and nothing is linked
Notes: Private is preselected. Privacy is up to the user and no further warnings are added. The whole log is one text file in the gist. Building against a stubbed connection is enough, so this does not block on the connect story.

Title: Disconnect GitHub
User Story: As a user, I want to disconnect my GitHub account, so that my access token is not left on a shared device
User Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: Given I am connected, when I disconnect, then the access token and the gist link are removed from the browser
AC2: Given I disconnected, when I look at the gist on GitHub, then the gist and its thoughts are unchanged
AC3: Given an unsaved draft, when I disconnect, then the draft is also removed
Notes: Disconnect also clears the draft so nothing is left on a shared device.

Title: Merge thoughts saved from two devices
User Story: As a user, I want writes from my phone and laptop to combine, so that neither device overwrites the other
User Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: Given two devices each saved a new thought since they last loaded, when both have saved, then the log holds both thoughts
AC2: Given the same thought was edited on both devices, when both have saved, then the one with the later edit time is kept
AC3: Given I deleted a thought on this device and no other device changed it since this device last loaded, when I save, then the thought is gone and no deletion marker is added to the file
AC4: Given I deleted a thought on this device and another device edited it since this device last loaded, when I save, then the later of the delete and the edit wins
AC5: Given the version of the gist this device last loaded cannot be fetched, when I save, then I am told and nothing is overwritten
AC6: Given the gist changes between my check and my save, when I save, then the app merges again before writing
Notes: The merge compares three things: the version this device last loaded from the gist's version history, this device's thoughts, and the gist's current version. Gists cannot refuse a save when they changed, so the app re-checks just before writing; this is best effort, not a guarantee. Building against a stubbed gist is enough.

Title: Refresh the log
User Story: As a user, I want to reload the log on demand, so that I see what I wrote on my other device
User Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: Given a thought was added from another device, when I refresh, then it shows in the log
AC2: Given I am midway through writing, when I refresh, then my draft is not erased
AC3: Given the gist cannot be read, when I refresh, then I see an error and the log I already had stays

Title: Write a thought
User Story: As a user, I want to type a thought in free-form text and save it, so that I capture it before it is lost
Notes: Only text is stored. Each thought gets a unique ID so devices can tell thoughts apart. On the size limit only a warning is shown for now. Building against a stubbed gist is enough.
Clarifications:
Q1: The acceptance criteria cell holds only the text "claud". Proposed criteria: a typed thought is saved with an automatic date and time and appears in the log; empty text is refused with a message; a save that fails keeps the text and shows an error; text over the size limit shows a warning (limit to be agreed). Can these be entered as AC1 to AC4?
A1:

Title: Keep an unsaved thought
User Story: As a user, I want my half-written text to survive a closed tab or a failed save, so that I never lose a thought
User Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: Given I typed text and did not save, when I close and reopen the app in the same browser, then my text is back in the box
AC2: Given a save fails, when I look at the box, then my text is still there and I can try again
AC3: Given a save succeeds, when it finishes, then the kept draft is cleared
AC4: Given the browser blocks keeping drafts on this device, when I type, then the app still works and tells me drafts cannot be kept

Title: Edit a thought
User Story: As a user, I want to correct a saved thought, so that the log stays accurate
User Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: Given a saved thought, when I change its text or tags and save, then the log shows the new text and keeps the original timestamp
AC2: Given the thought was deleted elsewhere, when I save, then I am told it no longer exists
AC3: Given the save to the gist fails, when I save, then my change is kept in the box and I see an error
AC4: Given I remove all the text, when I save, then I am told text is needed and the saved thought is unchanged
Clarifications:
Q1: The merge story keeps the edit with the later edit time, but this story keeps only the original timestamp; should an edited thought also record an edit time?
A1:

Title: Delete a thought
User Story: As a user, I want to delete a thought, so that I can remove what I do not want kept
User Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: Given a thought, when I delete and confirm, then it no longer appears in the log
AC2: Given I cancel the confirmation, when I look at the log, then the thought is still there
AC3: Given the gist update fails, when I delete, then the thought stays and I see an error
AC4: Given I delete a thought, when I confirm, then I am told the old text remains in the gist's version history on GitHub
Notes: GitHub keeps old versions of a gist, so deleted text stays readable there: only to the owner for a private gist, to anyone for a public one.

Title: Tag a thought
User Story: As a user, I want to add tags to a thought, so that I can find it later
User Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: Given a thought being written or edited, when I add a tag and save, then the tag is saved with the thought
AC2: Given a tag that differs from an existing one only in letter case or surrounding spaces, when I add it, then it is treated as the same tag
AC3: Given a tag longer than 30 characters, when I add it, then I am told it is too long and it is not added
AC4: Given an empty tag, when I add it, then it is not added

Title: View thoughts as a log
User Story: As a user, I want to read my thoughts newest first with date and time, like a git log, so that I can follow how my thinking moved
User Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: Given several thoughts, when I open the log, then each shows its date, time, text and tags, newest first
AC2: Given no thoughts, when I open the log, then I see an empty-log message
AC3: Given more than 50 thoughts, when I open the log, then the first 50 show and I can load the next 50
AC4: Given the gist cannot be read, when I open the log, then I see an error and a retry
AC5: Given the log file is over 1 MB, when I open the log, then every thought still loads
Notes: Building against a stubbed gist is enough.
Clarifications:
Q1: Are the gist limits as recalled: a file read in full by the API up to about 1 MB, and through its raw link up to about 10 MB? To be verified in the first build.
A1:

Title: Filter thoughts by tag
User Story: As a user, I want to show only thoughts with a given tag, so that I can see one theme
User Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: Given a chosen tag, when I filter, then only thoughts with that tag show, newest first
AC2: Given a tag with no thoughts, when I filter, then I see a nothing-found message
AC3: Given more than 50 thoughts have the chosen tag, when I filter, then the first 50 show and I can load the next 50

Title: Search thoughts by text
User Story: As a user, I want to search the text of my thoughts, so that I can find a half-remembered idea
User Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: Given a search word, when I search, then only thoughts containing it in any letter case, or tagged with it, show
AC2: Given a search word with no match, when I search, then I see a nothing-found message
AC3: Given I clear the search, when it clears, then the full log returns
AC4: Given more than 50 thoughts match the search, when I search, then the first 50 show and I can load the next 50
Clarifications:
Q1: Search also matches tags, which overlaps Filter thoughts by tag; should search match tags or only text?
A1:
